leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a branded type for a User ID using TypeScript's intersection types
Apply type assertions to convert primitive strings into branded ID types
Construct a function that validates and returns a branded ID from user input
Configure a function signature to accept only specific branded ID types as parameters
Manipulate existing code to replace primitive string IDs with branded types
Integrate branded ID types into a simple user profile object structure
Initialize variables with branded types and demonstrate type safety in assignments
